item.title: LOT-116: member profile screen (from a profile link in the reader)
item.body:
LOT-116
Closes #207
Claim: mac/lot-116

**Problem.** A member profile link in a topic opened the browser; the legacy profile screen (`UserProfileView.swift`, `ProfilViewController.m`) had no port.

**Cause.** Not ported yet; the reader routed `/hfr/profil-<n>.htm` as a plain web link (CHANGELOG-LEGACY row 53).

**Change.**
- `App/SwiftHFR/Profile/`: `UserProfileModel` (`@Observable @MainActor`, `ContentLoader` rules: load once, reload, content kept on a failed reload), `LiveUserProfileSource` (`PageFetcher.profile(as: .anonymous)` + LOT-027 parser; page refused unless served at `https://forum.hardware.fr/hfr/profil-<id>.htm`), `UserProfileView` (sheet: header, figures, sections, smileys, link rows; member text via `Text(verbatim:)`; images through `ReaderImageFetcher`, forum hosts only; links open in a browser per the default-browser setting, never with the session).
- Reader: `ReaderLinkAction.profile(memberID:)` from LOT-095's `.profile` route; `TopicReaderView` presents the sheet; `ReaderServices.profiles` built in `AppEnvironment`. `SafariView` made internal to reuse it.
- MP quick action is an **optional hook** (`onPrivateMessage`), unset here: LOT-128 (#398) wires it; LOT-118 adds the list buttons. Avatar / message-menu entry is LOT-087's.
- Why cookie-less: parser only verified on logged-out captures; logged-in, banned/deleted states are pending capture #124 (spec "Pending capture"). No new HFR fact.
- Spec `docs/lots/LOT-116-user-profile-screen.md`, `App/README.md` row, CHANGELOG-LEGACY row 58 (56 is taken by both #398 and #399).

**Tests** (`App/SwiftHFRTests/Profile/`, `TopicReaderModelTests`), no real HFR traffic:
- `UserProfileSourceTests`: `R56b` fetched once through the cookie-less client only and equal to the parser output; served at another member / home / other host / `http` / other port → `.unreadable`; a topic page → `.unreadable`; offline maps.
- `UserProfileModelTests`: one load on repeated appear; retry after failure; failed reload keeps profile; MP button only with hook and loaded pseudo; links → browser, `javascript:` ignored.
- `TopicReaderModelTests.aProfileLinkOpensTheProfileSheet` (old assertion that a profile is a web link moved to a topic list link).
- Shown to fail with the change reverted (routing line removed, `.authenticated`, URL check removed, `onAppear` guard removed): all 5 targeted tests failed.
- Full app suite green on iPhone 18 Pro and iPad Pro 13" (iOS 27.0) clones; visual check light / dark / XXXL / iPad on anonymized `R56a`/`R56b` through a temporary harness (not committed).

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Open member profiles directly from links in forum topics.
  * View profile details, status, summary figures, smileys, and action links, with refresh controls and loading or error feedback.
  * Send a private message from a profile when messaging is available. Profile links open in the app; other web links follow the selected browser setting.
  * Profile requests don’t use account cookies, and links that don’t match the expected profile address are rejected.

* **Documentation**
  * Added documentation for the profile screen and its behavior.

comments.body:
Walkthrough
The topic reader now routes recognized member profile links to a profile sheet. The sheet loads profile data anonymously, displays profile details and images, and supports refresh, private messaging, and link actions. **Changes: Member profile** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Profile loading and state**
`App/SwiftHFR/Profile/UserProfileSource.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Profile/UserProfileModel.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Profile/*`|Adds anonymous profile fetching with final-URL validation, profile loading and reload state, private-message recipient handling, and tests for source and model behavior.| |**Reader routing and sheet wiring**
`App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderModel.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderView.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Navigation/AppEnvironment.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/TopicReaderModelTests.swift`|Adds profile actions for matching reader links and connects them to a profile model and sheet through `ReaderServices`.| |**Profile sheet and supporting documentation**
`App/SwiftHFR/Profile/UserProfileView.swift`, `App/README.md`, `docs/CHANGELOG-LEGACY.md`, `docs/lots/LOT-116-user-profile-screen.md`|Adds profile fields, summary figures, smileys, action links, and image loading to the sheet. Adds documentation for the profile feature.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~20 minutes **Change:** Feature ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant TopicReaderView participant TopicReaderModel participant UserProfileModel participant UserProfileView participant LiveUserProfileSource TopicReaderView->>TopicReaderModel: Resolve link TopicReaderModel-->>TopicReaderView: Return profile(memberID) TopicReaderView->>UserProfileModel: Create model with member ID TopicReaderView->>UserProfileView: Present profile sheet UserProfileView->>UserProfileModel: Call onAppear() UserProfileModel->>LiveUserProfileSource: Request profile(memberID:) LiveUserProfileSource-->>UserProfileModel: Return profile or ListLoadError UserProfileModel-->>UserProfileView: Provide profile and loading state ``` **Possibly related issues** - ezzz/HFRnow#209: The profile action surface is present, but blacklist and whitelist handlers remain outside this change. - ezzz/HFRnow#422: The model supports an optional private-message callback, but the reader wiring does not set that hook. **Suggested labels:** `type: lot` **Suggested reviewers:** `moust4ki`
Merge Risk: Low · up to 34c91
Profile-sheet presentation lacks a regression test, and the changelog citations remain unresolved. Both are bounded follow-ups.
Security architecture risk: Low · up to 34c91
The profile screen keeps profile and image requests separate from the app’s signed-in session, and profile links open in a browser after user action. No material security regression was established. Production behavior for profile states not represented in the available captures remains unverified. **Retained concerns** No architecture-level concerns identified.
Security review details
**Security Blast Radius** - _inferred_ — The newly reachable surface is the viewing client’s profile sheet, anonymous profile/image requests and user-triggered browser navigation. The inspected flow does not grant profile content the app account’s transport authority or a private-message callback. **Security Findings and Attack Paths** - _observed_ — Member field links can reach external HTTP(S) destinations after a tap. This is an intentional browser handoff, not a destination allowlist: non-HTTP(S) schemes are ignored, and accepted links are not fetched through the app’s authenticated reader. **Trust Boundaries and Controls** - _observed_ — Profile image loading disables third-party access. The reused fetcher checks image policy on every redirect hop, uses anonymous transport by default, and enforces redirect, response-size and image-content-type limits. - _observed_ — Member identity is bound to the request and final URL, not independently recovered from the parsed body. UserProfile has no member-ID field. The current flow relies on the forum endpoint for body provenance and does not use that body to invoke the optional privileged callback. **Resilience and Maintainability Implications** - _observed_ — The sheet has no explicit dismissal-time loader cancellation. ContentLoader intentionally decouples its work from caller cancellation, so an anonymous fetch may continue after dismissal. Generation checks still prevent superseded results from committing to newer load state.
